_comment: Tuition figures are verbatim from 'WMS 2026-2027 Tuition Plans'. Mirrors FALLBACK.programs in src/lib/queries.ts — keep the two in sync.

programs.name: Infant & Toddlers
programs.mealNote: Families provide food, milk, or formula for infants. Once a child reaches 15 months and is eating solid foods, a catered organic lunch is served with parental approval.

programs.name: Toddler & Two's
programs.mealNote: All schedules include catered organic lunches and snacks.

programs.name: 3–6 Primary
programs.mealNote: All schedules include catered organic lunches and snacks. Children must be fully potty-trained for this program.

notes.earlyDropOff: For the school day program, early drop-offs before 8:30 AM may be arranged with the school for an additional fee.
notes.annualDiscount: Paying annually represents a 5% discount off monthly tuition.
notes.siblingDiscount: 10% discount applied to the tuition of the child with the lower rate.
notes.proration: Tuition is not prorated. Monthly rates already account for school closing days.
notes.registrationFees: A one-time application fee, a one-time family fee, and a refundable security deposit are due at registration. Amounts are not published in the handbook — contact the school.
